ref_speedup_note: Anchor 2.00 calibrated in oracle mode on NVIDIA H20. tests/ref_speedup.txt is authoritative at scoring; this file is only the in-image fallback. See tests/ref_speedup.caveat.md to re-measure on your hardware.
value_axis: achieved_fp16_tflops (compute-bound; wall-time tracks it). gpu_bench.py prints achieved-TFLOP/s per shape as work evidence; a real tensor-core win sits well above the general FMA-path roofline.
compile_note: gemm.py JIT-compiles gemm_kernel.cu with nvcc (torch cpp-extension) at scoring; a changed .cu forces a fresh recompile. Requires nvcc + CUDA headers + ninja in the image (see the Dockerfile build notes); H20 = sm_90; -ccbin g++-11 fallback.
